result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For a small company (5–50 employees), my top recommendation would be **BambooHR for HR management** or **Rippling if you want HR, payroll, and automation in one system**\.

However, the best choice depends on where your employees are located and how much HR administration you want to automate.

## My top 5 HR software recommendations

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. BambooHR**

(Best overall for HR)

- Employee records and document management
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Vacation and absence tracking
- Performance reviews and reporting

Best for companies wanting a dedicated, easy-to-use HR system.

Pricing: Quote-based; small-team minimums may apply.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Rippling**

(Best all-in-one platform)

- HR, payroll and benefits
- Employee onboarding automation
- Software and device management
- Workflow automation

Best for companies expecting to grow quickly.

Pricing: Modular, generally quote-based.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Factorial, el unicornio que da alas a la digitalización de la Gestión de Personas](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/s9PM2ozpD2tudL1lMSg7BobtOSc6QWCc18OBGIju8vcwMCiARvdCebNDbo05oztxjrsnCgvUNg1ctTFTTBqWtkqnxUkflnKJ4pF8xjjY15kbQvV5gh_2cJAByXgRiWM_e4sIp-K1Ivaj8Rr_gk9b_3G2VzVVjPqAQ51QVTHF9Qfp1RKMfxf9AXnnIBoESHFl?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Factorial**

(Best for small businesses)

- Employee management
- Time and attendance
- Vacation management
- Document workflows
- Performance management

Best for a small business wanting straightforward HR administration.

Pricing: Starting prices vary by plan and region.

[Factorial website](https://factorialhr.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee database
- Leave management
- Attendance tracking
- Performance management

Best for companies looking to keep software costs low.

Pricing: Free entry plan; paid plans available.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Gusto**

(Best for payroll + HR)

- Payroll processing
- Employee onboarding
- Benefits administration
- Tax filing

Best for small US-based companies wanting payroll and HR together.

Pricing: Starts around \$49/month + \$6 per employee.

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

These recommendations reflect 2026 software comparisons. ## What I would choose

| Your priority | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Best dedicated HR system | BambooHR |
| HR + payroll + automation | Rippling |
| Simple HR for a small team | Factorial |
| Lowest-cost HR management | Zoho People |
| Payroll + HR in the US | Gusto |


**One important consideration\:** If your company is based in Canada, make sure the software supports Canadian payroll, provincial employment requirements, and Canadian benefits administration. US-focused platforms aren't necessarily suitable.
